content.title: Product Maturity, Certifications & Release Management
content.content:
SnapLogic has been in production use for enterprise integration since 2008 — 16+ years of continuous platform operation and evolution. The platform's maturity is evidenced by its stable, certification portfolio, and structured release management programme.

**CERTIFICATIONS & COMPLIANCE**

- **SOC 2 Type II**: Annual SOC 2 Trust report covering Security, Availability, Processing Integrity, Confidentiality, and Privacy. Current report available under NDA.

- **SOC 1 Type II**: Controls relevant to financial reporting available under NDA.

- **GDPR**: Full compliance programme. Data Processing Agreement (DPA) available. EU data residency on AWS (Ireland, Frankfurt). Sub-processor register maintained and available on request.

- **ISO 27001:2013**: Security / ISO routinely assessed/ISO 27001 certification status.

- **HIPAA/HITECH**: Business Associate Agreement available for healthcare customers — evidence of regulated-industry compliance posture.

- **Penetration testing**: Annual third-party penetration tests conducted. Current report available under NDA.

**RELEASE MANAGEMENT & VERSION SUPPORT**

SnapLogic's structured release programme gives enterprise customers the predictability and control they need for production integration environments.

- **Release cadence**: Monthly platform releases for feature updates and security patches. Quarterly major releases for significant feature sets.

- **Customer upgrade control**: Customers receive a minimum 4-week grace period after each quarterly release before automatic upgrades. Customers may opt for manual-controlled upgrade schedules.

- **Version support: Minimum 12 months** of active support for each major release version.

- **Zero-downtime upgrades**: Control plane updates and multi-mode Ground Plex upgrades support rolling deployment — no scheduled maintenance window required for most updates.

- **Backward compatibility**: SnapLogic maintains backward compatibility across platform versions during the grace period. Pipeline artefacts and API integrations are not broken by platform updates.

**SUPPORT MODEL**

- **Support tiers**: P1 (critical) — 1-hour response, 4-hour resolution target. P2 — 4-hour response. P3/P4 — next business day.

- **Named CSM**: Dedicated Customer Success Manager assigned to enterprise accounts.

- **Response SLAs**: P1 (critical) — 1-hour response, 4-hour resolution target. P2 — 4-hour response. P3/P4 — next business day.

- **Support channels**: Web portal (24/7), email, phone (Platinum). Trust site snaplogic.com includes platform status and incident history.
